title: Signal-to-Runner Contract Matrix
goal: Require every adaptive runner to declare trigger signals, prerequisites, blockers, risk tier, cost, expected evidence, approval needs, report mappings, and follow-up candidates in a machine-readable contract before the AI planner can select it.
scope: Runner metadata, planner safety, and adaptive execution contracts.
generation_reason: AI cannot choose intelligently unless runners explain when they are useful, what evidence they need, and what proof they are expected to produce.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Contract metadata must strengthen runner selection and must not loosen approvals, scope, ROE, credential handling, or kill-switch behavior.

success_criteria: A contract schema exists and validates runner trigger signals, prerequisites, blockers, risk tier, cost, expected evidence, approval needs, and report mapping.
Planner selection refuses adaptive runner use when required contract fields are missing.
Tests prove at least one RUN, SKIP, WAIT, and APPROVAL decision from contract data.

acceptance_criteria: Missing contract data blocks adaptive selection with a clear error.
Contract-derived WAIT and APPROVAL states include blocker and approval reason IDs.
Existing manual/fixed-chain runner dispatch still works.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.
